row.name: Gunpowder
row.description: A grey-black powder made of volatile materials, used in explosives and slugthrower rounds. Can be carried in many forms, but is safest in a Chemical Storage Vessel. If exposed to an open flame or spark, it ignites violently. Damage: Deals 1d burning damage for a radius of 1d-2 feet (minimum 1 foot) per pound of powder. Partial Quantities: For amounts under 1 lb, roll the standard damage and distance, applying a -1 penalty to both the burning damage and the blast radius for every 0.1 lbs below a full pound. A total result of 0 or less yields no damage.
